item.title: Terrible accident claims six lives on Lagos-Ibadan Expressway
item.description: The Federal Road Safety Corps, FRSC, has confirmed that six people lost their lives, while 23 others sustained injuries in a lone road accident near Four Square Camp along the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway. item.title: 2027: APC constitutes central coordination committee ahead national convention
item.description: The All Progressives Congress (APC) has constituted a central coordination committee for its 2026 National Convention, in a move aimed at ensuring a smooth and well-organised party congress. The committee was announced in a statement signed by the APC National Secretary, Senator Surajudeen Ajibola Basiru. item.title: Nigerians in Diaspora petition Senate over unpaid compensation for Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway land
item.description: Nigerians in the Diaspora, under the coordination of Mrs Stella Okengwu, have petitioned the National Assembly over the alleged failure of the Federal Government to pay compensation for properties affected by the construction of the Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway in Okun Ajah, Eti-Osa Local Government Area of Lagos State.
